read.word: Deadpool (14 uses) and Bird-Brain (13) are not mutants on their pages: nearly every use is the comic title The New Mutants, where they first appeared. Phoenix Force (16) is a cosmic entity; its page says mutant because it retells X-Men stories. Starhawk's 'mutants' are the last of an alien race on Arcturus, a second sense of the word.
read.topic: Quasar's and Living Lightning's powers come from energy (the Quantum Bands; a lightning weapon), and 'energy' is one of the mutant topic's top words, so the topic pulls them in. Sean and Chris (542 words) reach θ 0.99 at K = 8 seed 0 with almost no topic words: short pages get extreme mixtures. Synapse's page describes two telepaths and never says what they are; neither the text nor the key settles her.
